pendingValidations: Obtain the required Phase 0 approval before any Figma mutations or Android UI edits.
Use the already-selected Figma desktop application path while the Starter-plan MCP quota is unavailable, or resume MCP writes if quota access returns.
Visually validate every page, component family, key state, and prototype connection after creation.
Do not start Compose implementation until the complete Figma screen set passes the self-review gate.
completedSteps: P0.a: Audited official Google Play pages and official visual evidence for UpFoto, Remini, PhotoRoom, and B612.
P0.b: Audited current Compose navigation, AlphaPics screens, compressor, Batch, History, ads, daily tokens, Room, tests, application identity, and screenshot coverage.
P0.c: Created and inspected the dedicated empty Figma file; confirmed no existing local variables, styles, components, or frames conflict with the redesign.
P0.d: Discovered the subscribed Material 3 Design Kit and identified compatible primitive components for selective reuse.
P0.e: Locked the v1 foundations, component families, screen/state inventory, prototype flows, and code-to-design boundaries.
P0.f: Established a successful pre-design Kotlin compile baseline with no production source changes.

researchSynthesis.UpFoto: Photo-selection simplicity, immediate enhancement entry, restrained controls, and clear Before/After proof.
researchSynthesis.Remini: Result-first enhancement workspace with a dominant image canvas, one-tap processing, and progressive enhancement categories.
researchSynthesis.PhotoRoom: Contextual editor organization, explicit export, cutout correction, and a separate multi-photo Batch workspace.
researchSynthesis.B612: Compact bottom tool rail, sliders, thumbnail strips, selected states, and cancel/apply ergonomics.
researchSynthesis.AlphaPics: Original dark photo-centric synthesis; no copied assets, proprietary presets, wording, branding, or pixel layouts.

foundations.colorSource: Match the existing AlphaPicsTheme Compose tokens: deep black/navy surfaces, electric blue, restrained violet/cyan, semantic text, border, success, warning, and danger.
foundations.gridsAndSafeAreas: 412 x 915 primary Android frame plus 360 x 800 compact checks; 18 dp horizontal content margin; explicit status, navigation, keyboard, and ad-safe zones.
foundations.effects: Subtle elevation, canvas scrim, selected-tool glow, and focus treatment only; no pervasive blur or glow.

implementationBoundaries: Home becomes photo-first and stops being a feature-card catalog.
New enhancement/editor UI uses honest states and never fabricates processed output.

Existing compression engine, Target Size, Quality, Batch processing, MAX_BATCH_ITEMS, Room History, Camera, Gallery, Save, Share, ads, token rules, applicationId, and signing assumptions remain protected.
Navigation is bridged through the current MainActivity state model with minimal risk; no wholesale navigation migration.
No new AI provider, network call, generated background, image generation, video, or fake transform is introduced.

blockers.detail: The connected Figma MCP returned its Starter-plan tool-call quota error after file creation and discovery. The user also selected the Figma desktop application, which is the approved fallback path after Phase 0 approval.
